findings.observation: A hand cart has been left in the aisle.
findings.evidence: The cart stands in the middle of the travel path with no one using it.
findings.recommendation: Park the cart in a marked parking area off the aisle.

findings.observation: Boxes are stacked across the pedestrian walkway.
findings.evidence: The stack covers the marked walkway between the yellow floor lines.
findings.recommendation: Clear the walkway and move the boxes to racking or a staging zone.

findings.observation: Loose packaging is on the floor near the walkway edge.
findings.evidence: Strips of packaging material are visible next to the floor line.
findings.recommendation: Pick up the packaging and put it in a waste bin.

findings.observation: A loaded pallet is blocking most of the aisle.
findings.evidence: The pallet takes up the aisle width, leaving little room to walk past.
findings.recommendation: Move the pallet to its storage location before the aisle is used.
